projects.description:
OpenGloves is currently a windows only, OpenVR driver for DIY Virtual Reality Gloves.


I would like to port it to Monado, making it available on Linux and OpenXR.

projects.description: This project adds support for a Head Tracked Fish Tank Display for monoscopic devices in Monado. It uses the laptop webcam/phone camera to track the user's face pose and position. The final display appears as a magic window, the view of which changes according to the movement of the head.
